featured.title: IPORA
featured.subtitle: IP-management platform
featured.role: Built it end to end, then Project Manager
featured.summary: The operations team's daily system of record, with 52 IP services live.
featured.problem: Trademark, patent, copyright and industrial-design portfolios were run from spreadsheets and inboxes.
did: Built the platform end to end on a commercial admin base: data model, modules, role-scoped access and backend integration.
Bilingual Arabic/English with genuine right-to-left layouts.
After the business rejected a completed Power BI build, re-scoped reporting as a custom module.
Founded the QA practice: 530+ automated Selenium test cases across 170+ features, cutting manual regression by 40%.
Wrote 59 pages of developer documentation that halved onboarding.
Led a cloud migration with zero downtime.
featured.outcome: 52 IP services live; the operations team's daily system of record.
